## Sales Pipeline

A Kanban board of Opportunities grouped by pipeline stage, with sort (value, probability, stalest) and a close-window filter (all, this week, month or quarter). Columns come from the Pipeline Stage field, and the board is the catalog Board.

```gts
import SalesPipeline from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/crm/components/sales-pipeline';

<SalesPipeline @items={{this.opportunities}} @onOpen={{this.open}} />
```

It takes `@items` from the consumer rather than running its own query, so it works the same over a live realm search or a fixed list. A close-window filter looks forward: a deal with no close date hasn't been forecast, so it never counts as closing inside a window.

### Example

Five opportunities across qualified, discovery, proposal, negotiation and closed won.

### Non-goals

Moving deals between stages; the board is read-only here, since a stage change belongs to the command or form that records why.
